description: This Java class defines an Hibernate interceptor named ImmutableOrderInterceptor for the Order entity within the OpenMRS project. Its purpose is to restrict modifications to certain properties of Order objects, allowing only specific fields (like dateStopped, voided, etc.) to be mutable, ensuring the immutability of order data except for designated fields.

classes.name: ImmutableOrderInterceptor
classes.description: Hibernate interceptor for the Order entity in OpenMRS, ensuring only specific fields are mutable.

methods.name: getSupportedType
methods.description: Returns the class type that this interceptor supports, which is the Order class.

methods.name: getMutablePropertyNames
methods.description: Provides the list of property names that are allowed to be modified for Order objects.

methods.name: ignoreVoidedOrRetiredObjects
methods.description: Indicates whether voided or retired objects should be ignored by the interceptor; returns true.
